calibration_frames.description: Stable standing frames required. Increasing improves calibration but delays readiness.

phase_confirm_frames.description: Consecutive frames required for a phase change. Increasing is more tolerant of jitter.

bottom_confirm_frames.description: Consecutive bottom frames required. Increasing rejects more bounce-style reversals.

ascent_confirm_frames.description: Consecutive rising frames required. Increasing is more tolerant of velocity jitter.

measurement_smoothing_window.description: Median window for state and feature measurements. Increasing smooths more but adds lag.

maximum_consecutive_invalid_frames.description: Pose-loss frames allowed mid-rep. Increasing is more tolerant of brief occlusion.

return_confirm_frames.description: Consecutive upright frames required to finish. Increasing rejects brief false lockouts.

visibility_threshold.description: Minimum mean visibility across the tracked side. Increasing is stricter about tracking.

core_visibility_threshold.description: Minimum visibility for shoulder, hip, knee, and ankle. Heel or foot confidence alone does not reject a rep.

reliable_visibility_mean.description: Minimum mean visibility for scoring. Increasing is stricter about pose quality.

reliable_visibility_min.description: Minimum observed visibility for scoring. Increasing is stricter.

minimum_valid_frame_ratio.description: Required fraction of valid frames. Increasing is stricter.

minimum_valid_frames.description: Minimum samples in a completed rep. Increasing rejects more short reps.

maximum_side_width_ratio.unit: shoulder/hip width divided by body scale
maximum_side_width_ratio.description: Maximum apparent left-right width for side-on placement. Increasing is more tolerant of camera angle.

side_switch_visibility_margin.description: Visibility advantage needed to switch sides while idle. Increasing favors side stability.

minimum_body_frame_fraction.description: Minimum body height in frame. Increasing rejects cameras that are farther away.

maximum_body_frame_fraction.description: Maximum body height in frame. Increasing tolerates a closer camera.

frame_edge_margin.description: Required clearance from image edges. Increasing requires more space around the body.

standing_knee_min.description: Minimum knee angle accepted during calibration. Increasing demands a straighter stance.

standing_hip_min.description: Minimum hip angle accepted during calibration. Increasing demands a straighter stance.

descent_knee_delta.description: Bend needed to start descent. Increasing ignores more small knee bends.

descent_hip_drop.description: Hip drop supporting descent detection. Increasing ignores more small movements.

minimum_rep_rom.description: Minimum knee range for a countable rep. Increasing rejects more partial attempts.

bottom_knee_angle.description: Knee angle that can enter BOTTOM after adequate ROM. Increasing recognizes bottom earlier.

bottom_hip_drop.description: Hip displacement that supports bottom detection. Increasing requires more descent.

bottom_velocity.description: Maximum absolute knee velocity near bottom. Increasing is more tolerant of no pause.

ascent_velocity.description: Positive knee velocity needed for ascent. Increasing is stricter.

return_knee_tolerance.description: Allowed final knee flexion. Increasing is more tolerant.

return_hip_tolerance.description: Allowed final hip flexion. Increasing is more tolerant.

lockout_knee_delta.description: Clearly flexed final knee used for feedback. Increasing is more tolerant.

lockout_hip_delta.description: Clearly flexed final hip used for feedback. Increasing is more tolerant.

maximum_rep_duration.description: Timeout for an attempt. Increasing permits slower reps.

minimum_rep_duration.description: Shortest reliably scoreable rep. Decreasing permits faster reps.

shallow_knee_angle.description: One shallow-depth signal. Decreasing makes the rule more tolerant.

shallow_min_rom.description: Second shallow-depth signal. Decreasing makes the rule more tolerant.

shallow_hip_knee_margin.description: Hip clearly above knee at bottom. Making it more negative is more tolerant.

shallow_min_hip_drop.description: Hip-drop shallow signal. Decreasing makes the rule more tolerant.

heel_lift_threshold.description: Sustained heel rise needed for feedback. Increasing is more tolerant.

heel_lift_strong_threshold.description: Large heel rise that is reportable even when the detected bottom window is brief.

heel_lift_bottom_fraction.description: Persistence required for heel feedback. Increasing is more tolerant of brief jitter.

maximum_torso_lean.description: Absolute lean signal selected conservatively from labelled data. Increasing is more tolerant.

maximum_torso_change.description: Relative lean signal. Increasing is more tolerant of squat style/body proportions.

chest_collapse_rise_difference.description: Hip rise exceeding shoulder rise during ascent. Increasing is more tolerant.

chest_collapse_lean_change.description: Required forward-tip corroboration. Increasing is more tolerant.

uncontrolled_rep_duration.description: Fast-rep signal, used only with a second signal. Decreasing is more tolerant.

uncontrolled_descent_duration.description: Fast-descent signal, used only with a second signal. Decreasing is more tolerant.

uncontrolled_descent_velocity.description: High descent velocity signal. Increasing is more tolerant.

good_probability_threshold.description: High-confidence GOOD boundary. Decreasing labels more reps good.

bad_probability_threshold.description: High-confidence BAD boundary. Decreasing requires stronger bad confidence.

strong_rule_confidence.description: Rule confidence needed to override the model quality result. Increasing is more tolerant.

strong_rule_severity.description: Rule severity needed to override the model quality result. Increasing is more tolerant.

minimum_feedback_rule_confidence.description: Minimum confidence before naming a correction. Increasing suppresses more uncertain cues.

minimum_feedback_rule_severity.description: Minimum severity before naming a correction. Increasing ignores more minor errors.

feedback_cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum delay before repeating the same spoken cue. Increasing reduces repetition.

feedback_labels.excessive_torso_lean: Keep your chest a little more upright.
feedback_labels.chest_collapse: Drive your hips and chest up together.
feedback_labels.uncontrolled_tempo: Slow down and control the descent.
feedback_labels.general: Try to keep the repetition smooth and controlled.

decision_policy.confident_good: p_good >= high_confidence_good unless a severe high-confidence rule fires
decision_policy.borderline: BAD only for a strong rule; otherwise BORDERLINE

feature_contract.coordinates: MediaPipe normalized x/y; positive y points downward
feature_contract.torso_lean: absolute shoulder-to-hip inclination from vertical in degrees
feature_contract.distances: normalized by calibrated shoulder-to-ankle body scale
feature_contract.smoothing: MediaPipe landmark smoothing plus five-frame median measurement filtering
